1000152757::la.description: JOB DESCRIPTION Moore & Van Allen, PLLC, a large southeastern law firm with a national practice, is seeking an experienced commercial lending lawyer for its entertainment finance practice. Position will be located in our Charlotte or Atlanta office. Preferred candidates would have a minimum of three years of commercial lending experience, a working knowledge of syndicated credit facilities and acquisition finance transactions and an interest in music and film finance. Excellent academic performance and strong interpersonal skills are required. Competitive compensation package includes full benefits. Lateral Recruiting Contact: Staci Litis ( [email protected] ) JOB REQUIREMENTS Law Degree Eligibility for North Carolina Bar admission is preferred. BENEFITS AT MOORE & VAN ALLEN We are committed to supporting our attorneys in achieving a fulfilling work-life balance. Our comprehensive benefits program offers a range of options to promote your well-being and professional growth. Health and Wellness: We provide multiple health insurance plans, including a Health Savings Account option. You’ll also have access to dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage, as well as telehealth services. Financial Security: Enjoy a Cash Balance Pension Plan (for members) or Flexible Spending Accounts (for non-members), Life Insurance, and Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance. We also offer Short & Long Term Disability coverage and a Financial Wellness Program to help you plan for the future. Work-Life Balance: Take advantage of our Maternal/Paternal Parental Leave policy, generous Holiday and Vacation Pay, and Bereavement Leave. We also prioritize your overall well-being with a Body Wellness Program and an Employee Assistance Program. Relocation & Bar Support: We reimburse reasonable relocation expenses and cover bar application and review costs to help make your transition to Moore & Van Allen as smooth as possible. ABOUT MOORE & VAN ALLEN Moore & Van Allen is more than just a law firm—we’re a strategic partner invested in our clients’ success. Consistently ranked in the Am Law 200, we’ve been delivering innovative legal solutions since 1945. Our commitment goes beyond traditional legal services; we champion our clients’ ideas, values, and aspirations, ensuring they receive clear perspectives and unexpected solutions to their complex challenges. This unwavering client focus has fueled our growth into one of the largest law firms in the Southeast. With a team of over 400 talented attorneys and professionals, we offer expertise in over 90 areas of practice, serving clients across the nation and around the globe. From Fortune 500 companies and financial institutions to healthcare innovators and technology leaders, our clients benefit from our strategic and innovative approach to high-stakes business transactions, intricate legal matters, and complex disputes. Our seven decades of experience are the foundation of our value. We’re a nationally recognized firm with a vibrant, inclusive culture and a deep commitment to our community. We understand that true success comes from the power of collaboration and the strength of ideas.

Position will be located in our Charlotte or Atlanta office. Preferred candidates would have a minimum of three years of commercial lending experience, a working knowledge of syndicated credit facilities and acquisition finance transactions and an interest in music and film finance. Excellent academic performance and strong interpersonal skills are required. Competitive compensation package includes full benefits. Lateral Recruiting Contact: Staci Litis ( [email protected] ) JOB REQUIREMENTS Law Degree Eligibility for North Carolina Bar admission is preferred. BENEFITS AT MOORE & VAN ALLEN We are committed to supporting our attorneys in achieving a fulfilling work-life balance. Our comprehensive benefits program offers a range of options to promote your well-being and professional growth. Health and Wellness: We provide multiple health insurance plans, including a Health Savings Account option. You’ll also have access to dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage, as well as telehealth services. Financial Security: Enjoy a Cash Balance Pension Plan (for members) or Flexible Spending Accounts (for non-members), Life Insurance, and Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance. We also offer Short & Long Term Disability coverage and a Financial Wellness Program to help you plan for the future. Work-Life Balance: Take advantage of our Maternal/Paternal Parental Leave policy, generous Holiday and Vacation Pay, and Bereavement Leave. We also prioritize your overall well-being with a Body Wellness Program and an Employee Assistance Program. Relocation & Bar Support: We reimburse reasonable relocation expenses and cover bar application and review costs to help make your transition to Moore & Van Allen as smooth as possible. ABOUT MOORE & VAN ALLEN Moore & Van Allen is more than just a law firm—we’re a strategic partner invested in our clients’ success. Consistently ranked in the Am Law 200, we’ve been delivering innovative legal solutions since 1945. Our commitment goes beyond traditional legal services; we champion our clients’ ideas, values, and aspirations, ensuring they receive clear perspectives and unexpected solutions to their complex challenges. This unwavering client focus has fueled our growth into one of the largest law firms in the Southeast. With a team of over 400 talented attorneys and professionals, we offer expertise in over 90 areas of practice, serving clients across the nation and around the globe. From Fortune 500 companies and financial institutions to healthcare innovators and technology leaders, our clients benefit from our strategic and innovative approach to high-stakes business transactions, intricate legal matters, and complex disputes. Our seven decades of experience are the foundation of our value. We’re a nationally recognized firm with a vibrant, inclusive culture and a deep commitment to our community. We understand that true success comes from the power of collaboration and the strength of ideas.

1000152802::boston.title: Employment Litigation Associate
1000152802::boston.description: The Louisville, Kentucky office of FBT Gibbons is seeking a Product, Tort & Insurance Litigation Associate. FBT Gibbons LLP is a national, full-service law firm formed through the combination of Frost Brown Todd and Gibbons, bringing together more than 800 attorneys across 26 offices. Our attorneys offer comprehensive legal solutions to clients ranging from Fortune 500 companies and global multinationals to startups and nonprofits. FBT Gibbons distinguishes itself as a dynamic, forward-moving firm with a coast-to-coast footprint and a reputation for excellence across multiple practice areas and industries. Our reputation is further reinforced by its numerous Chambers and Best Lawyers ranked practices and attorneys. We are a people‑first firm recognized for our award-winning inclusive culture and a strong commitment to community and pro bono work. FBT Gibbons supports our attorneys with structured training and mentorship, clear paths to advancement, and a platform that provides exposure to varied and sophisticated matters. Qualifications 2–4 years of Insurance, Product Liability, or Tort Litigation experience Experience with written discovery, depositions, drafting pleadings and substantive motions Skilled in mediations, court appearances, and assisting with pretrial or pre-arbitration preparations Superior academic credentials and excellent research and writing skills Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team Kentucky licensure or ability to obtain it in the short-term Compensation The salary range for this role is $160,000-$175,000, reflecting a variety of factors including experience, training, licensure, certifications, and organizational needs. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, relevant experience, and other job-related factors, consistent with applicable employment laws. Associates are also eligible for: • Quarterly and annual objective bonuses, with maximum objective bonus opportunities ranging from approximately $14,000 to $22,000 per year , depending on associate level • Annual subjective bonus Benefits FBT Gibbons offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including: Medical (HSA with employer contribution or PPO options) Dental and vision coverage Life insurance Short- and long-term disability Various parental leaves Sick and vacation time Well-being/EAP support Generous 401(k) retirement plan Why FBT Gibbons? At FBT Gibbons, we believe great lawyering starts with a great workplace. Our attorneys benefit from a hybrid work environment (three days in-office), a “dress for your day” policy, and robust support for both professional and personal development. Associates have a clear, competency-based, path to partnership, and formalized mentorship and active Affinity & Ally Networks foster connection, growth, and belonging. Attorneys are encouraged to engage in pro bono work, community partnerships, and professional organizations, with opportunities for leadership and recognition. Our commitment to diversity is a fundamental driver of business success, and our diversity efforts are embedded in the firm’s core values and strategic priorities. Our approach to diversity strengthens our collaboration, the way we serve clients, our ability to attract top talent, and how we innovate as a firm. FBT Gibbons remains steadfast in our dedication to an environment where every individual can thrive, develop, and reach their full potential within our firm and while championing diverse perspectives within the broader community. Learn more about our culture and commitment to inclusion at fbtgibbons.com/about/diversity-inclusion . FBT Gibbons LLP is an equal opportunity employer. FBT Gibbons is not accepting search firm or recruiter submissions for this position. Unsolicited submissions from search firms will not be considered.
